issues.title: Identity forks on cold load: partner link and logs appear lost (new anonymous user minted)
steps: Onboard a persona, link a partner via Connect.
Reload the app / open it in a fresh browser launch with the saved session (cold load).
Open Connect.
issues.expected: Same anonymous user, partner link and logs still there.
issues.actual: Several parallel auth token refreshes fire on cold load; one fails with "refresh token already used", after which the app silently creates a NEW anonymous user. Partner link and daily logs stay with the old user, Connect falls back to "Generate code" and the user believes their link/data is gone. Happened to both personas several times on day 1 (Meera 4 user ids, Arjun 3). Fix: serialise/lock the token refresh (single-flight), never auto-signup when a stored session exists, offer recovery via backup code. | Midday: both personas kept same anon/user ids across sequential act.js sessions (no fork this pass). Risk remains on multi-client/cold refresh_token_already_used. || 2026-10-07 catch-up: NO fork — Meera anon_2d240f4f…/45db52d2… and Arjun anon_0a7e58a7…/b92f1fcb… held across cold loads (dashboard goto, reload, /settings goto) using one client per persona. Intermittent root cause (parallel token refresh) not disproven; keep open.
issues.retest_note: Not reproduced: anon/auth user ids stable on all loads 21 Oct. Cold-load race not specifically re-tested.
issues.fix_evidence: Cold loads 22 Oct after more than 1 h of token expiry, plus two aborted contexts whose state was not saved: auth user ids unchanged for both personas, partner link intact. Fork not reproduced.
